mapper.sql: field_id, field_rule_id, field_scope_key, field_serial_id, field_period, field_serial_no, field_record_time, field_record_finish_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_number_record ( field_id, field_rule_id, field_scope_key, field_serial_id, field_period, field_serial_no, field_record_time, field_record_finish_time ) VALUES ( #{model.fieldId}, #{model.fieldRuleId}, #{model.fieldScopeKey}, #{model.fieldSerialId}, #{model.fieldPeriod}, #{model.fieldSerialNo}, NOW(), NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE field_serial_no = LAST_INSERT_ID(IF(field_record_finish_time IS NULL, field_serial_no + 1, #{model.fieldSerialNo})), field_record_time = NOW(), field_record_finish_time = NULL
